Immutable verification-point definition. Runtime state and evidence live in
post-run ledger records, never in the pre-run manifest payload.

platform_validation_manifest.description:
Pre-run immutable input. Its own digest, status, evidence, logs, and summary
are structurally absent and therefore cannot participate in its digest.
platform_validation_manifest.title: PlatformValidationManifestPayload

PluginContextDescriptor.description:
The complete per-mount plugin context descriptor.

Root `PluginHost`, SQLite/DB pools, Capability or Session registries,
EventBus, `AppServices`, `GatewayDeps`, ambient filesystem roots, credential
stores, and arbitrary service locators are intentionally absent.

target_package_inventory.description:
Digest input for the target first-party contribution inventory.

The payload intentionally has no digest field. Use
[`TargetPackageInventoryArtifact`] to attach its canonical digest.
target_package_inventory.title: TargetPackageInventoryPayload
